title: Soft Thresh
comment: Soft Thresh — Classic reference: David Donoho, Iain Johnstone, Ideal spatial adaptation by wavelet shrinkage, 1995. Introduces the soft thresholding to solve denoising by leveraging the sparsity of the data in some dictionary (e.g. wavelets).

title: Sdp Optim

title: Nesterov
comment: Nesterov — Gradient descent is consistent with a first-order ODE. Nesterov's acceleration is consistent with a second-order ODE. Nesterov is faster in the worst case but gradient is better for strongly convex functions. https://arxiv.org/abs/1503.01243
